description: Low-level bridge for hiding and showing the main Thunderbird window (mail:3pane) and for intercepting its close button. Contains no policy: background.js decides when to call it.

interceptClose.description: Hide the last main window instead of closing it when its close button is used.

minimizeToTray.description: Hide the main window when it is minimized.

functions.name: hide
functions.description: Hide all visible main windows. If no main window is loaded yet, the next one is hidden as soon as it loads.

functions.name: show
functions.description: Show all hidden main windows and focus the most recent one.

parameters.name: activationToken
parameters.description: Optional xdg-activation token (Wayland) used to legitimately raise the window.

functions.name: toggle
functions.description: Hide the main windows if they are visible and active, otherwise show and focus them.

functions.name: isHidden
functions.description: Resolves to true if main windows exist and all of them are hidden.

functions.name: getEnvironment
functions.description: Resolves to { wayland: boolean, desktop: string } describing the display server and the XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP value.

functions.name: quit
functions.description: Request a regular application quit (same path as File > Quit). Resolves to false if the quit was cancelled.

events.name: onVisibilityChanged
events.description: Fired when the main windows were hidden or shown.
